---
title: "Earth and Planetary Geophysics"
subtitle: "Three dataset options for your EAES 380 final project"
---

*EDI is primarily an ecological/environmental repository, so pure planetary geophysics datasets are limited. The options below emphasize geophysical measurements (thermal profiles, stratigraphy, seismic context) within Earth-system contexts.*

### 1. [Bonanza Creek Boreholes](bnz-boreholes.qmd)

*Bonanza Creek LTER: Borehole Temperature Data from Permafrost Site near Fairbanks, Alaska (2009–2021)*

Temperature profiles from deep boreholes (40–75 m) in permafrost near Fairbanks, Alaska.

EDI package: `knb-lter-bnz.792.2`

### 2. [AK Wildfire & Permafrost](ak-wildfire-permafrost.qmd)

*Interior Alaska: Climate and Wildfire Effects on Permafrost Soil Temperature Regimes (Hourly Data, 2013–2018)*

Hourly soil temperature measurements at depths from 5 to 150 cm at paired burned and unburned sites in Interior Alaska.

EDI package: `knb-lter-bnz.717.2`

### 3. [VCR Seismic Stratigraphy](vcr-seismic-stratigraphy.qmd)

*Trend Surface Analysis and Seismic Stratigraphy of the Virginia Coast Reserve*

Sediment grain-size, organic-matter, and stratigraphic data from vibracores, interpreted together with high-resolution seismic records to reconstruct the pre-transgression landscape and Holocene/Pleistocene boundary on the Virginia Coast Reserve (Hog Island Bay area).

EDI package: `knb-lter-vcr.15.19`
